name: Resident Evil 2
notes: RE Engine → D3DMetal (RE4 remake / Village class). This is the 2019 remake (883710), not the 1998 original. Launch re2.exe with SteamAppId=883710. Ray tracing is DXR via D3DMetal on M3/M4; the dx11_non-rt Steam beta is the fallback if device creation fails. Pin CX_GRAPHICS_BACKEND=d3dmetal. Do not use Libraries.rgl or Libraries.vk.
